title: Nervo Óptico, Procura-se um Novo Olho
original_title: Nervo Óptico, Procura-se um Novo Olho
overview: This documentary chronicles the history of the group Nervo Óptico, which pioneered artistic avant-garde movements in Porto Alegre (RS) during the 1970s, spanning the fields of mail art, performance, photography, and art cinema.
